channel: Which TV channel should broadcast this video?

daypart.instruction: In which part of the day would a TV viewer most want to watch this video?
daypart.morning: Light, upbeat, informative, short; news, quick updates
daypart.primetime: High production, entertaining, big events, films, worth full attention
daypart.latenight: Calm, niche, deep-dive, ambient, late chill or edgy humour

timely: Is this video time-sensitive, so that its value drops within a few days (news, live event, trend)?

fit.instruction: Using the viewer profile in `viewer`, how much would this specific viewer enjoy this video right now? Judge topic, tone and creator against the profile; ignore general popularity.
levels: Not for this viewer: off-topic or annoying
Unlikely: only loosely related to the profile
Perfect: exactly what this viewer seeks out
